args.body:
Dear City Hub Tokyo Group Bookings Team,

I am writing to inquire about availability for a group stay of 10 people in June. Could you please provide information on room options, rates, and any group-specific amenities or requirements?

My name is Emma Johnson, and I am representing Blue Sparrow Tech. Please let me know the next steps for booking and any necessary details you may need from my end.

Thank you for your assistance.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
